# The Miner Island

> The Miner Island sells new and refurbished ASIC cryptocurrency mining hardware, shipped worldwide from our Hong Kong warehouse on DDP-paid terms. We are a US-registered company (The Miner Island Company LLC) and accept cryptocurrency payment only.

We stock ASIC miners across five algorithms: Bitcoin (SHA-256), Kaspa (kHeavyHash), Litecoin and Dogecoin (Scrypt), Zcash and Horizen (Equihash), and Monero (RandomX). Brands include Bitmain, MicroBT, IceRiver, Goldshell, Canaan, and ElphaPex, organized by coin, by brand, and by budget tier so buyers can match hardware to their power rate and goals.

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Ships from our Hong Kong warehouse, typically within 24 to 72 hours.
- DDP-paid pricing: the price on each product page is the landed cost, with duties and customs prepaid. No surprise customs invoice and no broker fees.
- Free DDP shipping on orders over $5,000.
- Cryptocurrency payment only, via Plisio: Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and other major assets. A 3% discount applies to orders paid in Bitcoin. We do not accept credit cards, bank wire transfers, PayPal, or any fiat method.
- Operated by The Miner Island Company LLC, a Maine, USA limited liability company in good standing since 2019, BBB-listed and D-U-N-S registered.
- Contact: WhatsApp +1 617 300 8178, email sales@theminerisland.com.

## Shop by coin

- [Bitcoin (BTC) ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/bitcoin-miners-shop): SHA-256 hardware from Bitmain, MicroBT, and Canaan.
- [Kaspa (KAS) ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/kheavyhash-miners): kHeavyHash miners from IceRiver, Bitmain, and Goldshell.
- [Litecoin and Dogecoin (Scrypt) ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/scrypt-miners): Merge-mined LTC and DOGE on the Scrypt algorithm.
- [Zcash (ZEC) ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/equihash-miners): Equihash miners for Zcash and Horizen.
- [Monero (XMR) ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/randomx-miners): RandomX hardware.
- [Altcoin ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/altcoin-mining-rigs): Wider altcoin and algorithm coverage.
- [Refurbished ASIC miners](https://theminerisland.com/refurbished-asics): Tested refurbished units at lower entry cost.
